comment: Slices are good; fold in four decisions from the person, then re-slice. (1) B9 record-policy config key is `record.policy` (values local|remote, default local): write it into spec.md B9 and slice 07. (2) D11/B27: a local record is set aside as superseded ONLY after a takeover without a release; after a clean `norn story handoff` the old holder's copy is removed quietly (no Check item): amend D11, B27 and slice 13. (3) No fallback reading run state from runs/ in the base tree: only the archive ref is read; repos that have not run `norn upgrade` are pointed to it (doctor/status): record this in spec.md (Implementation decisions) and slices 15/16. (4) Split slice 05: 05 moves run state to the machine dir for new units only; a new slice right after it moves open stories off their branch at the first tick (B34), renumbering later slices and their depends_on and the NN prefixes in spec.md frontmatter criteria.
